name: Keep
rulesText: If defeated in a raid, after the attacker takes what they targeted, place your pawn at this site and end the action. _Do not burn favor, move pawn, etc._

name: Alchemist
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Gain [favor] [favor] [favor] [favor] from any favor bank or banks.

name: Martial Culture
rulesText: If you're an Exile and defeat another Exile, you may become a Citizen. _Follow the steps in the rules and end your Act Phase._

name: Tinker's Fair
rulesText: [favor] [favor] [favor] **ACTION:** Draw a relic from the relic deck.

name: Disgraced Captain
rulesText: [favor] [favor-burnt] +4 [attack-die] if the defender rules an [suit-order] card _(even an adviser)_.

name: Book Burning
rulesText: If you're victorious in a raid, burn all [secret] on the defender's board except their last [secret].

name: Magician's Code
rulesText: [favor] [favor] If you're challenging the Darkest Secret, gain [secret] [secret] and place them on the banner along with any other [secret] you're placing _(even none)_.

name: Inquisitor
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Guess the name of a facedown Vision _(even the Conspiracy)_ held by a player whose pawn is at your site. If you are correct, discard it.

name: Long-Lost Heir
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** if you're an Exile, you may become a Citizen. _Follow the steps in the rules and end your Act Phase._

name: Memory of Home
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Move all [favor] from any one favor bank to the [suit-hearth] bank.

name: Quick Exit
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Place an enemy pawn at your site onto any other site.

name: Bewitch
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** if you're an Exile and have the most [secret] _(even on cards)_, you may take a random relic from the Reliquary and become a Citizen. _Follow the steps in the rules and end your Act Phase._

name: Vow of Silence
rulesText: You **cannot** challenge the Darkest Secret. Whenever an enemy burns [secret-burnt], you take those secrets.

name: Forgotten Vault
rulesText: Enemies of Forgotten Vault's ruler **cannot** target relics held by its ruler. If ruled by Empire, all Imperials have this power.

name: Vow of Division
rulesText: You **cannot** take the Challenge action. Whenever an enemy burns [favor-burnt], you take that favor unless it was burned by a raid targeting you.

name: Royal Ambitions
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** if you're an Exile and rule the most sites, you may take a random relic from the Reliquary and become a Citizen. _Follow the steps in the rules and end your Act Phase._

name: Salt the Earth
rulesText: If you're victorious in a conquest, bury all cards at one site you targeted.

name: Riots
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** discard all denizens at sites in this region. Burn the same number of [favor] from the People's Favor.

name: Relic Thief
rulesText: [favor] [secret] **ACTION:** Choose a faceup relic held by a player whose pawn is at your site. Roll [defense-die] equal to its defense. If you roll no [shield], take it.

name: Gossip
rulesText: After an enemy plays an adviser facedown _(including a Vision)_, gain [favor] from the [suit-discord] bank.

name: Bandit Chief
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** kill one warband at each site not ruled by the bandits.

name: Defame
rulesText: After trading with a [suit-discord] card, burn [favor-burnt] from any player board.

name: A Round of Ale
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** return all [favor] and [secret], and flip your [secret], as in the Rest Phase.

name: Relic Breaker
rulesText: **ACTION:** Bury a relic you hold to gain [secret].

name: Ballot Box
rulesText: [favor] [favor] **ACTION:** If you have an adviser matching a card at this site, replace all warbands on this site with your warbands. Remove any that can't be replaced.

name: Deed Writer
rulesText: **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** You may give, receive, and swap sites. Old ruler moves warbands from site to their board, and new ruler moves warbands to site from their board.

name: Ancient Pact
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** if you're an Exile and hold the Darkest Secret, you may take a random relic from the Reliquary and become a Citizen. _Follow the steps in the rules and end your Act Phase._

name: Family Wagon
rulesText: You have no adviser limit but may only have [suit-beast] advisers—bury other advisers you have or would gain.

name: Relic Worship
rulesText: [secret] After recovering a relic, gain 2 Supply.

name: Vow of Union
rulesText:
At the start of any campaign, you may move any number of warbands from sites you rule in your region to your board or vice versa.

You may only have [suit-beast] advisers—bury other advisers you have or would gain.

name: Giant Python
rulesText:
[secret] **ACTION:** If you hold the Darkest Secret, move Giant Python to another site, and you may discard a card there first.

Other cards at this site **cannot** be used for non-persistent powers or placing [favor] or [secret].

name: Forest Council
rulesText: Enemies of Forest Council's ruler **cannot** place [favor] or [secret] on [suit-beast] cards or use their non-persistent powers.

name: Bracken
rulesText: [secret] You may put all of the cards you discard on the top or bottom of any one discard pile _(even your region's)_.

name: Golem Legions
rulesText: You may muster by placing [favor] on Golem Legions. _It counts itself as a matching adviser._

name: Council Arbiter
rulesText: **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** You may give, receive, and swap advisers. _You cannot exchange locked advisers. You still follow your adviser limit._

name: Catacombs
rulesText: [secret] If this site has an empty relic slot, draw a relic from the relic deck and place it here facedown.

name: Ward of Silence
rulesText: X [secret] **ACTION:** Choose a player whose pawn is at your site. Flip X [secret] on their board facedown.

name: Vow of Wisdom
rulesText: You **must** gain [secret] instead of [favor] when you play to a site.

name: Arcane Brokers
rulesText: [favor] **ACTION:** Discard a relic you hold to gain [secret] [secret].

name: Disciples
rulesText: If you have the Darkest Secret, spend only 2 Supply if you're searching the world deck.

name: Arcane Armor
rulesText: X [secret] Set X [attack-die] you have collected to their [skull] face instead of rolling them.

name: Glamor
rulesText: You may also target [secret] on your enemy's board except their last. Add [attack-die] for each targeted. If you're victorious, take them.

name: Wizard's Conclave
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** the player who rules the most [suit-arcane] cards takes the Darkest Secret. You decide ties. _Don't remove secrets from it._

name: True Oath
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** if you rule at least three other [suit-beast] cards, you may change the Oathkeeper goal.

name: Bog
rulesText: **ACTION:** Discard a relic you hold to gain [favor] [favor] [favor] from the [suit-beast] bank.

name: Whispering Leaves
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Choose a player whose pawn is at your site. They **must** place [favor] [favor] on this card.

name: Bed of Roots
rulesText: [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Bury a faceup adviser you have _(even if locked)_ to gain [secret] [secret].

name: Autumn Wind
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** shuffle together all discard piles, then deal these cards to the discard piles as evenly as possible. You decide ties.

name: Shifting Fog
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** move all favor in each favor bank to the next bank to the right. [suit-hearth] moves to [suit-discord].

name: Fae Battalion
rulesText: If you have the Darkest Secret, you may count each [hollow-sword] as a [sword] instead.

name: Hunger
rulesText: **WAKE:** You **must** bury an adviser held by a player whose pawn is at your site _(even yourself)_, but **cannot** bury this card.

name: Signal Trees
rulesText: [secret] Reveal the top three cards of your region's discard pile. +2 [attack-die] per revealed [suit-beast]. Discard all of the revealed cards.

name: Forest Garden
rulesText: If you play a [suit-beast] card to a site, you may bury a card at the site first.

name: Bandit Paymaster
rulesText: [favor] **ACTION:** Remove a bandit from your site except the last to gain 3 warbands.

name: Reliquary Raid
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** take a random relic from the Reliquary.

name: Tracker
rulesText: **ACTION:** Choose an enemy pawn at your site and end your Act Phase. **WAKE:** If you chose a pawn last turn, you may place your pawn at their site.

name: Banner Breakers
rulesText: [favor] [favor-burnt] +3 [attack-die] if the defender has the Darkest Secret or People's Favor.

name: Pledge to Discord
rulesText: Your advisers all have the [suit-discord] suit instead of their printed suit. _Marriage counts as two [suit-discord]._

name: Friendly Familiar
rulesText: [secret] Act as if your pawn is at any site. _You may use Trade modifiers at the site._

name: Unstable Summon
rulesText: If you hold the Darkest Secret, burn X [secret] from it to collect X [attack-die].

name: Bandit Prince
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** you may replace all bandits at any sites you choose with your warbands.

name: Dark Enforcer
rulesText: [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** Discard all [suit-order] and [suit-hearth] cards from your site.

name: Spoiled Supplies
rulesText: [favor] **ACTION:** Enemies with a pawn at your site each lose 1 Supply.

name: Old Songs
rulesText: You may trade with cards that have exactly one [secret] on them.

name: Diplomat
rulesText: Players **cannot** campaign against you unless they rule a [suit-hearth] card.

name: Village Idiot
rulesText: After mustering with this card, gain [favor] from the [suit-hearth] bank.

name: Spinning Bee
rulesText: Declare a suit. Draw from your discard pile until you draw a matching card. If you draw none, discard them all. You **cannot** use other Search modifiers.

name: Firebrand
rulesText: [secret] **ACTION:** Add [favor] to the People's Favor from any favor bank, or burn [favor-burnt] from the People's Favor.

name: Watchdog
rulesText: + [defense-die] if any target is in the Cradle.

name: Favored Son
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** take the People's Favor. If you do, adjust its [favor] using its left ribbon.

name: Town Meeting
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** gain [favor] from any favor bank for each [suit-hearth] card you rule. _This includes your advisers, even Town Meeting._

name: League Treaty
rulesText: During the Rest Phase of any player, League Treaty's ruler may move any [favor] from cards in its region to any one favor bank.

name: Skilled Merchants
rulesText: You may trade with any denizens in your region.

name: Tribute Spoils
rulesText: [favor] If you're victorious in a conquest, take [favor] for each card at targeted sites from the matching favor bank.

name: Search Party
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** peek at the bottom 3 cards of a discard pile and play one as if you searched. _Return the rest._

name: Moving Market
rulesText: After trading with Moving Market, you may move this card to any site with capacity. If you do, gain [favor] from the [suit-nomad] bank.

name: Traveling Negotiator
rulesText: **WHEN NEGOTIATING:** You may negotiate with any player.

name: Pledge of Defense
rulesText: +X [defense-die] X equals all [suit-nomad] cards you rule. At end, discard this card.

name: The Red Seer
rulesText: [secret] [secret-burnt] [secret-burnt] **ACTION:** If you hold the Darkest Secret, change the Oathkeeper goal to anything but Devotion.

name: Royal Stables
rulesText: Travel costs one less Supply _(minimum 1)_.

name: Call for Help
rulesText: **WHEN PLAYED,** reveal and discard up to 6 cards from your region's discard pile. Gain 2 warbands for each revealed [suit-nomad] card.

name: Vow of Wandering
rulesText:
Gain two more warbands.

You **cannot** place warbands on sites.

name: Mounted Library
rulesText: If trading on Mounted Library for [secret], gain double the [secret], then discard Mounted Library.

name: Master at Arms
rulesText: You may reroll any number of dice that show hollow swords [hollow-sword] once.

name: Baron
rulesText: You may play to any site you rule, and you may discard a card from that site first.

name: Honor Guard
rulesText: [favor] [favor] [favor-burnt] **ACTION:** Choose a player with no [suit-order] advisers whose pawn is at your site. Bury a faceup adviser they have.

name: City Wall
rulesText: While at this site, enemies of City Wall's ruler **cannot** place [favor] or [secret] on cards or use non-persistent powers.

name: Fearsome General
rulesText: Each [skull] you roll adds two more [sword] _(4 total)_, even if the [skull] is ignored _(Outriders, etc.)_.

name: Careful Plans
rulesText: [favor] The defender **must** roll their [defense-die] before the attacker rolls their [attack-die].

name: Garrison Armory
rulesText: [favor] In a conquest, warbands on targeted sites each add +2 defense _(instead of +1)_.

name: Battle Axes
rulesText: ±2 [attack-die] if your enemy rules a [suit-beast] card.

name: Great Feast
rulesText: [favor] **ACTION:** Discard a [suit-beast] card at your site to gain 3 Supply.

name: Quartermaster
rulesText: **WAKE:** If you rule this card, gain 1 Supply.
